headline_marked: DU [[suspended 3 teachers]] for opposing July uprising
headline: DU suspended 3 teachers for opposing July uprising
summary: The university authorities took the action based on investigation committee recommendations; the teachers deny the allegations and claim political harassment.
details: Dhaka University authorities have suspended three professors over allegations that they opposed the July 2024 uprising. The suspended teachers are Prof M Wahiduzzaman and Prof Muhammed Mahbubur Rahman of the Institute of Education and Research, and Prof Mashiur Rahman of the Department of Sociology.
Additionally, associate professor Md Ziaur Rahman (alias Sayeem Rana) of the Department of Music was suspended for allegedly not fulfilling the requirements to become a teacher in the department.

The decision was made during DU’s Syndicate meeting on Monday night, based on recommendations from university-formed investigation committees, according to DU Acting Registrar Munshi Shams Uddin Ahmed.
The university has also formed tribunals to deal with the allegations against the suspended faculty members.
The suspended teachers have denied the allegations, accusing the DU administration of politically motivated harassment and a lack of due process.

Prof Mashiur Rahman claimed the measures were aimed at suppressing teachers with progressive views, while Prof Wahiduzzaman described the decision as 'extreme injustice, falsehood, and arbitrariness'.
Prof Mahbubur Rahman stated that he had actually supported students during the movement and helped detained students secure their release.
This follows a previous Syndicate session in July where three other teachers, including Professor Sadeka Halim, were suspended over separate allegations.
In the same Syndicate meeting, the university also decided to extend the closing time of female students’ dormitory gates by one hour, moving the closing time to 11:00 PM.
The extension comes after students from three platforms have been demonstrating for over a month demanding 24-hour access to their residential halls.

headline_marked: Power and Energy Minister [[Iqbal Hasan Mahmud admitted to hospital]]
headline: Power and Energy Minister Iqbal Hasan Mahmud admitted to hospital
summary: The minister was moved to the Coronary Care Unit (CCU) of Ibrahim Cardiac Hospital after suffering from fever, cold, and cough.
details: Power and Energy Minister Iqbal Hasan Mahmud has been admitted to the Coronary Care Unit (CCU) of Ibrahim Cardiac Hospital in Dhaka.
The minister was admitted on Tuesday night around 11 PM, according to his personal assistant, Abdullah Kayes.
According to Kayes, the minister had been suffering from fever, cold, and cough since Tuesday evening.
He was first brought to the emergency department of Ibrahim Cardiac Hospital at around 10:30 PM before being moved to the CCU.
